apply.title: Apply for training
apply.intro: Choose up to {{max}} courses and put them in order. Your first choice is the one you want most.
apply.duplicate: Each course can be chosen only once
apply.onlyOpen: Only courses that are open for applications are listed.
apply.alreadyApplied: You already have an application for this cycle.
apply.nothingOpen: No course is open for applications right now.
apply.pickCycle: Choose a training cycle and a course on the Courses page first.
apply.introOne: Choose the one course you want to join this cycle.

mine.title: My enrollment
mine.intro: Track your application and its status.
mine.withdrawBody: You can apply again while the enrollment window is open.
mine.lockedHint: This application can no longer be changed.

admin.title: Enrollments
admin.intro: Applications that meet your automatic approval rules are approved as soon as students submit them. The rest are listed newest first: approve, reject with a reason, or waitlist, one at a time or in bulk.
admin.search: Search by student name, email or roll number
admin.caption: Applications
admin.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters

auto.title: Automatic approval
auto.intro: When this is on, every application that meets the rules below is approved the moment a student submits it, and the student is told at once. Applications that don’t meet them wait here for you, with the reason.
auto.manualIfPrerequisites: Courses with prerequisites need my review (the system can’t check them)
auto.saveFirst: Save the rules before approving what is already pending.
auto.confirmBody: Every pending application in {{cycle}} that meets the saved rules will be approved now and the students told. The rest stay pending for you.
